name: lens
description: Personal review standards for AI agents — runner, Stop-hook enforcement, run log

interface.shortDescription: Personal review standards enforced before a deliverable ships.
interface.longDescription: Lens runs your named review standards as a buddy reviewer, enforces them with a Stop hook so a deliverable can't finish un-reviewed, and logs every run. On Codex the reviewer and hooks are doctor-managed into ~/.codex/.
defaultPrompt: Run my lens on this deliverable before we finish.
